verdict.rationale: Exporting all of your data and leaving is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack documents no data export, bulk download, or offboarding capability. The JSON terminal messaging, OpenAPI definition files, and real-time data sync are related features, not a documented way to export all account data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
